Vehicle-2-X Facilities (V2xFac)

AUTOSAR Classic Off-board Comm. Services-Modul Vehicle-2-X Facilities (V2xFac, Spezifikation: AUTOSAR_CP_SWS_V2XFacilities.pdf, AUTOSAR_SWS_V2XFacilities.pdf).

  • void V2xFac_Init (void* CfgPtr); Initializes the V2x Fac module.

  • void V2xFac_DenBs_MainFunction (void); This is the main processing function of the DEN basic service.
  • Std_ReturnType V2xFac_V2xM_CommitPseudonymChange (void); This function is called by the V2x M when all modules are OK with the pseudonym change and the change is to be committed.
  • Std_ReturnType V2xFac_V2xM_AbortPseudonymChange (void); This function is called by the V2x M when not all modules are OK with the pseudonym change and the change is to be rolled back.

  • void V2xFac_IviS_MainFunction (void); This is the main processing function of the IVI service.

Name V2x Fac_ Vehicle Role Type Kind Type Derived from uint8 Range V2XFAC_ VEHICLEROLE_ DEFAULT 0x00 default vehicle role as indicated by the vehicle type V2XFAC_ VEHICLEROLE_ PUBLIC_ TRANSPORT 0x01 vehicle is used to operate public transport service V2XFAC_ VEHICLEROLE_ SPECIAL_ TRANSPORT 0x02 vehicle is used for special transport purpose, e.g. oversized trucks V2XFAC_ VEHICLEROLE_ DANGEROUS_ GOODS 0x03 vehicle is used for dangerous goods transportation V2XFAC_ VEHICLEROLE_ ROAD_ WORK 0x04 vehicle is used to realize roadwork or road maintena nce mission V2XFAC_ VEHICLEROLE_ RESCUE 0x05 vehicle is used for rescue purpose in case of an accident, e.g. as a towing service V2XFAC_ VEHICLEROLE_ EMERGENCY 0x06 vehicle is used for emergency mission, e.g. ambulance, fire brigade V2XFAC_ VEHICLEROLE_ SAFETY_ CAR 0x07 vehicle is used for public safety, e.g. patrol V2XFAC_ VEHICLEROLE_ AGRICULTURAL 0x08 vehicle is used for agriculture, e.g. farm tractor V2XFAC_ VEHICLEROLE_ COMMERCIAL 0x09 vehicle is used for transportation of co mmercial goods V2XFAC_ VEHICLEROLE_ MILITARY 0x0a vehicle is used for military purpose V2XFAC_ VEHICLEROLE_ ROAD_ OPERATOR 0x0b vehicle is used in road operator missions V2XFAC_ VEHICLEROLE_ TAXI 0x0c vehicle is used to provide an authorized taxi service V2XFAC_ VEHICLEROLE_ RESERVED_1 0x0d reserved for future usage V2XFAC_ VEHICLEROLE_ RESERVED_2 0x0e reserved for future usage V2XFAC_ VEHICLEROLE_ RESERVED_3 0x0f reserved for future usage Descri ption Enumeration of DE_ Vehicle Role as defined in ETSI TS 102 894 - 2. requirement SWS_V2xFac_00092 [SWS_V2xFac_00092] 📄 PDF

V2x Btp _ Transmit V2x Btp.h This API is called by the V2x Fac module to request sending a BTP - PDU to the peer BTP entity. V2x M _ Calc Distance V2x M.h Calculates the distance between two geographical points on earth with the assumption that they are on elevation 0. V2x M _ Calc Heading - In Tolerance V2x M.h Calculates if difference of heading values are within a tolerance value V2x M _ Get Position - And Time V2x M.h Provides the instantaneous position information. V2x M _ Get Ref Time Ptr V2x M.h Provides a pointer to the time reference of the V2X - Stack. V2x M _ Set Tolling - Zone Information V2x M.h Set available tolling zone information. This is done from V2x Fac that receives this information via CAM messages.

requirement SWS_V2xFac_00246 [SWS_V2xFac_00246] 📄 PDF

The V2xFac module shall implement the IVI Service as specified in [20] unless specified otherwise in this document

requirement SWS_V2xFac_00248 [SWS_V2xFac_00248] 📄 PDF

The data elements which constitute the content of the IVIM shall be compliant to [21] .

requirement SWS_V2xFac_00249 [SWS_V2xFac_00249] 📄 PDF

Upon receiving a IVIM, the IVI service makes the content of the IVIM available to the V2X Applications. Received IVIMs shall be sent to the upper application layer v ia their standardized AUTOSAR service interface V2xApplRxIndicationIvim. For Details see [20] chapter 7

requirement SWS_V2xFac_00254 [SWS_V2xFac_00254] 📄 PDF

For the V2X_Facilities an interfac e V2xApplRxIndicationIvim shall be provided as defined below to provide the capability of delivering received IVIMs to applications .

requirement SWS_V2xFac_00256 [SWS_V2xFac_00256] 📄 PDF

The V2xFac module shall imple ment the RLT Service as specified in [20] unless specified otherwise in this document .

requirement SWS_V2xFac_00257 [SWS_V2xFac_00257] 📄 PDF

The data elements which constitute the content of the MAPEM shall be compliant to [22] .

requirement SWS_V2xFac_00258 [SWS_V2xFac_00258] 📄 PDF

Upon receiving a MAPEM, the RLT service makes the content of the MAPEM available to the V2X Applications. Received MAPEMs shall be sent to the upper application layer via their standardized AUTOSAR service interface V2xAppl RxIndicationMapem. For Details see [20] chapter 6 .

requirement SWS_V2xFac_00260 [SWS_V2xFac_00260] 📄 PDF

For the V2X_Facilities an interface V2xApplRxIndicationMapem shall be provided as defined below to provide the capability of delivering received MAPEMs to applica tions .

requirement SWS_V2xFac_00264 [SWS_V2xFac_00264] 📄 PDF

The V2xFac module shall implement the TLM Service as specified in [20] unless specified otherwise in this document .

requirement SWS_V2xFac_00265 [SWS_V2xFac_00265] 📄 PDF

The data elements which constitute the content of the S PATEM shall be compliant to [22] .

requirement SWS_V2xFac_00266 [SWS_V2xFac_00266] 📄 PDF

Upon receiving a SPATEM, the TLM service makes the content of the SPATEM available to the V2X Applications. Received SPATEMs shall be sent to the application layer via their standardized AUTOSAR service interface V2xApplRxIndicationSpatem . For details see [20] chapter 5 .

requirement SWS_V2xFac_00323 [SWS_V2xFac_00323] 📄 PDF

[SWS_V2xFac_00323] Low Frequency Container reception ⌈This interface provide the low frequency data for the CAM message. It needs to be updated initially and afterwards when a parameter is changing within the data structure. It is important to provide this data structure BEFORE the CAM message is triggered with the call to the service interface V2xFacVdp()⌋

requirement SWS_V2xFac_20444 [SWS_V2xFac_20444] 📄 PDF

For a stationary vehicle, the system shall report the last estimated heading value.

requirement SWS_V2xFac_20445 [SWS_V2xFac_20445] 📄 PDF

At system shutdown, the system shall store the last heading value and the corresponding gear position (forward, neutral or backward). At system start - up, the system shall report the heading value based on this stored heading value and the current gear position, until the vehicle is no longer stati onary.

V2xFac_V2xM_AbortPseudonymChange função

This function is called by the V2x M when not all modules are OK with the pseudonym change and the change is to be rolled back. A vailable via V2x Fac_ V2x M.h

SWS_V2xFac_00092 requirement

V2x Btp _ Transmit V2x Btp.h This API is called by the V2x Fac module to request sending a BTP - PDU to the peer BTP entity. V2x M _ Calc Distance V2x M.h Calculates the distance between two geographical points on earth with the assumption that they are on elevation 0. V2x M _ Calc Heading - In Tolerance V2x M.h Calculates if difference of heading values are within a tolerance value V2x M _ Get Position - And Time V2x M.h Provides the instantaneous position information. V2x M _ Get Ref Time Ptr V2x M.h Provides a pointer to the time reference of the V2X - Stack. V2x M _ Set Tolling - Zone Information V2x M.h Set available tolling zone information. This is done from V2x Fac that receives this information via CAM messages.

SWS_V2xFac_00246 requirement

The V2xFac module shall implement the IVI Service as specified in [20] unless specified otherwise in this document

SWS_V2xFac_00248 requirement

The data elements which constitute the content of the IVIM shall be compliant to [21] .

SWS_V2xFac_00249 requirement

Upon receiving a IVIM, the IVI service makes the content of the IVIM available to the V2X Applications. Received IVIMs shall be sent to the upper application layer v ia their standardized AUTOSAR service interface V2xApplRxIndicationIvim. For Details see [20] chapter 7

SWS_V2xFac_00254 requirement

For the V2X_Facilities an interfac e V2xApplRxIndicationIvim shall be provided as defined below to provide the capability of delivering received IVIMs to applications .

SWS_V2xFac_00256 requirement

The V2xFac module shall imple ment the RLT Service as specified in [20] unless specified otherwise in this document .

SWS_V2xFac_00257 requirement

The data elements which constitute the content of the MAPEM shall be compliant to [22] .

SWS_V2xFac_00258 requirement

Upon receiving a MAPEM, the RLT service makes the content of the MAPEM available to the V2X Applications. Received MAPEMs shall be sent to the upper application layer via their standardized AUTOSAR service interface V2xAppl RxIndicationMapem. For Details see [20] chapter 6 .

SWS_V2xFac_00260 requirement

For the V2X_Facilities an interface V2xApplRxIndicationMapem shall be provided as defined below to provide the capability of delivering received MAPEMs to applica tions .

SWS_V2xFac_00264 requirement

The V2xFac module shall implement the TLM Service as specified in [20] unless specified otherwise in this document .

SWS_V2xFac_00265 requirement

The data elements which constitute the content of the S PATEM shall be compliant to [22] .

SWS_V2xFac_00266 requirement

Upon receiving a SPATEM, the TLM service makes the content of the SPATEM available to the V2X Applications. Received SPATEMs shall be sent to the application layer via their standardized AUTOSAR service interface V2xApplRxIndicationSpatem . For details see [20] chapter 5 .

SWS_V2xFac_00268 requirement

For the V2X_Facilities a n interface V2xApplRxIndicationSpatem shall be provided as defined below to provide the capability of delivering received SPATEMs to applications .

SWS_V2xFac_00323 requirement

[SWS_V2xFac_00323] Low Frequency Container reception ⌈This interface provide the low frequency data for the CAM message. It needs to be updated initially and afterwards when a parameter is changing within the data structure. It is important to provide this data structure BEFORE the CAM message is triggered with the call to the service interface V2xFacVdp()⌋

SWS_V2xFac_20444 requirement

For a stationary vehicle, the system shall report the last estimated heading value.

SWS_V2xFac_20445 requirement

At system shutdown, the system shall store the last heading value and the corresponding gear position (forward, neutral or backward). At system start - up, the system shall report the heading value based on this stored heading value and the current gear position, until the vehicle is no longer stati onary.
